headline.title: Apple to pay $250M to settle lawsuit over Siri’s delayed AI features
headline.summary: Apple has reached a $250 million settlement in a class action lawsuit that accused the company of overpromising the release of AI features for its Siri voice assistant. The settlement addresses claims that consumers were misled about the capabilities and timeline of Siri's enhancements.

articles.title: 5 gardening tips you can try right in Search
articles.summary: The article provides five practical gardening tips that users can easily implement through search engines. These tips aim to enhance gardening practices by leveraging online resources and information.

articles.title: Using AI for Just 10 Minutes Might Make You Lazy and Dumb, Study Shows
articles.summary: A recent study indicates that using AI assistants for just 10 minutes may impair cognitive abilities and problem-solving skills. Researchers warn that increased reliance on these technologies could lead to decreased mental engagement.

articles.title: vLLM V0 to V1: Correctness Before Corrections in RL
articles.summary: The article discusses the transition from vLLM version 0 to version 1, emphasizing the importance of ensuring correctness in reinforcement learning (RL) models before implementing any corrections. It highlights the key improvements and methodologies adopted in the new version to enhance model reliability and performance.

articles.title: SpaceX may spend up to $119B on ‘Terafab’ chip factory in Texas
articles.summary: SpaceX is considering a proposal to invest up to $119 billion in a new semiconductor manufacturing facility in Texas, dubbed the "Terafab" project. The facility aims to be a multi-phase, vertically integrated site for advanced computing and semiconductor fabrication.

articles.title: DeepSeek could hit $45B valuation from its first investment round
articles.summary: Chinese AI lab DeepSeek is poised to achieve a valuation of $45 billion following its initial investment round. The company gained attention in early 2025 for developing a large language model that operates with significantly lower compute power and costs compared to major U.S. competitors.

articles.title: How Elon Musk left OpenAI, according to Greg Brockman
articles.summary: Greg Brockman provides insights into the contentious negotiations surrounding Elon Musk's departure from OpenAI, highlighting the challenges faced by startup founders in such high-stakes environments. The article sheds light on the dynamics of decision-making within the organization as it evolved into a significant player in the AI landscape.

articles.title: Ethos raises $22.75M from a16z for its expert network with voice onboarding
articles.summary: Ethos has secured $22.75 million in funding from Andreessen Horowitz to enhance its expert network, which currently onboards 35,000 experts weekly using voice technology. The investment aims to further develop Ethos's platform and expand its capabilities in connecting experts with users.

articles.title: At TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, all your M&A questions will be answered
articles.summary: At TechCrunch Disrupt 2026, industry leaders from Coinbase, M13, and Mignano Law Group will discuss the role of mergers and acquisitions as a strategy for early-stage companies. Attendees can register to participate in the live event and gain insights into M&A practices.

articles.title: Mira Murati tells the court that she couldn’t trust Sam Altman’s words
articles.summary: Mira Murati, former CTO of OpenAI, testified in the Musk v. Altman trial that CEO Sam Altman misled her regarding the safety standards for a new AI model. During her deposition, she claimed Altman falsely asserted that the legal department had approved the model's safety.

articles.title: 3 days left to lock in 50% off a second ticket to TechCrunch Disrupt 2026
articles.summary: TechCrunch is offering a promotion for its Disrupt 2026 event, allowing attendees to purchase a second ticket at 50% off when they buy the first ticket. This offer is valid until May 8 at 11:59 p.m. PT.

articles.title: AI boom pushes Samsung to $1T
articles.summary: Samsung's valuation surpassed $1 trillion, driven by increased demand for AI-related chips, marking it as the second Asian company to achieve this milestone after TSMC. The surge in shares reflects the growing impact of artificial intelligence on the semiconductor market.
